name: io.github.namixai/funding-mcp
title: Usenami Funding MCP
description: Multi-venue perp funding rates, arbitrage spreads, open interest and slippage for agents.

environmentVariables.name: USENAMI_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the Usenami API base URL (default: https://api.usenami.io)

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base wallet private key holding USDC. Set it and the paid tools auto-pay via x402; leave it unset and they return the payment requirements instead.
